charts.title: CoRoT-7 b: orbits around CoRoT-7
charts.description: The orbits of CoRoT-7's planets in this map from above, to scale, with CoRoT-7 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Haywood et al. 2014 (2014MNRAS.443.2517H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HAYWOOD_ET_AL__2014): P 0.85359165 d

charts.title: CoRoT-7 b: its transit
charts.description: CoRoT-7 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (6, 33, 87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 280304863, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
